dict.string: Paste the three setup values from Baymax into the Text actions above. This reads the last seven days of Steps, Exercise Minutes, Water, and Sleep. It sends selected samples only to your configured Baymax address, which stores daily summaries. It never writes to Apple Health. Health actions run on iPhone, not Mac.
Paste the sync address from Baymax (your Mac network address for local use).
Paste your private connection key from Baymax.
Paste the time zone shown in Baymax.
